title: FarmProfile
description: Canonical contract for registered Farm profiles and geographic boundaries in AgroShift (Module 01 - Farm Management & Location Intelligence).

farm_id.description: Unique identifier of the farm (e.g. farm-peshawar-001 or UUID).

owner_name.description: Full name of the farm owner / farmer.

contact_phone.description: Contact phone number formatted for local or international dialing.

preferred_language.description: Preferred interaction language for the farmer.

total_area_hectares.description: Total area of the farm in hectares.

irrigation_source.description: Primary irrigation method or source for the farm.

current_crops.description: Currently standing or planted crops on the farm.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last update.

FarmLocation.description: Centroid or primary GPS reference coordinate and address details.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (-90 to 90).

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (-180 to 180).

elevation_meters.description: Elevation above sea level in meters.

village_or_town.description: Local village, town, or mouza name.

province_or_region.description: Province or administrative territory (e.g., Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Punjab).

FarmBoundary.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon representing the parcel boundary.
